messages:
eva: Postmortem follow-up: we need to remap owners for all remediation items, lock down flag scopes, and agree auto-rollback thresholds. Starting a short sync thread to track. TL;DR: assign owners + tentative deadlines by EOD Tue.

matt: ack. can we prioritize the canary sampling fix first? saw two regressions this week.

sophia: agree. propose: sampling to 5% -> 0.5% for next 48h while we push hotfix. owner: me. ETA: tomorrow noon UTC.

alex: I'll take flag-scoping task. need a spec: reduce global flag exposure, add region-bound scope + per-team kill switch. ETA: Fri EOD.

tara: +1 on kill switch. need RBAC check with security. tagging @ryan for compliance signoff.

ryan: got it. I'll review RBAC and KMS access by Thu.

eva: For auto-rollback: suggested thresholds: 5% error increase OR 3x latency p50 relative to baseline for 10 minutes -> trigger immediate rollback. Proposal: start conservative thresholds and iterate. Opinions?

matt: thresholds look fine. can we add a "grace window" so noisy metrics don't flip rollback during infra blips? e.g., require 3/5 consecutive windows.

sophia: yes to grace. also add manual-confirm channel to stop rollback during major holidays (if oncall wants to override).

deploy-bot: NOTICE: Pilot canary policy v2 deployed to prod cluster canary-1 at 07:03 UTC.

eva: Great. Action items summary (short):
- sophia: canary sampling fix -> owner sophia -> ETA 2025-11-12T12:00Z -> ticket INF-4821
- alex: flag scoping + regional kill switch -> owner alex -> ETA 2025-11-14T23:59Z -> ticket INF-4824
- ryan: RBAC/KMS review -> owner ryan -> ETA 2025-11-13T18:00Z -> ticket SEC-129
- matt: rollback heuristics + grace windows -> owner matt -> ETA 2025-11-13T10:00Z -> ticket OPS-811

alex: I'll add RFC doc to the shared drive and link in the ticket. worklog attached.

sophia: I'll post short test plan: load + A/B vs baseline + false positive stress test.

eva: Let's also add recurring monitor for regression patterns: schedule 2-week lookback runbook that flags themes (latency spikes, tail errors, config flips). owner: eva. cadence: weekly review.

matt: can someone add these as milestones in the postmortem doc? I can do it if no one else.

eva: please do, matt. assign to me for weekly audits.

tara: quick Q: do we need to change rollout tooling to allow region-scoped feature flags? alex?

alex: yes, will include API changes in RFC. minimal change: add region list param to flag manifest and enforce at runtime.

sophia: test suggestion: include synthetic traffic that mimics country-specific spikes to validate region-scoped flags.

eva: OK. final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: if you accept ownership & timeline. we'll reconvene Tue standup for status.

matt: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

ryan: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: REMINDER: Next canary policy evaluation scheduled in 6h.
